menu.name: Sushi no Midori — Nagoya Sakae Mitsukoshi

menus.label: Sakae Mitsukoshi exclusive set menus
menus.note: Both prices include tax. October 31 opening at 11:00; advance-booked visits begin November 9. Reservations opened October 9 online only, not by telephone or in store. Same ordered product required across the group; children ten and under can choose at the restaurant. General brand grand-menu page explicitly lists seven other branches, including older Nagoya, and excludes this new Sakae branch: its prices and seasonal offers are not copied here. Checked exact operator branch/gallery, operator October opening release, landlord renewal/menu and linked TableCheck set/seat plans. Full new-branch à la carte menu and drink prices remain unpublished. Booking: 90-minute table seating only, no counter reservations. Include children in guest count; groups of five or more use multiple tables, adjacent tables not guaranteed. Book by preceding-day 21:00. Change/cancel requested by three days before; cancellation charges 50% from three days before through preceding day, 100% on day. More than thirty minutes late without contact may cancel booking. Guest-count/seat changes cannot be made through comments; avoid strong fragrances. Tell staff about allergies and requested no-wasabi/small rice portions. New direct restaurant phone remains unpublished; department-store switchboard is not a restaurant phone.
